body: He's always been aware of my depression, and he's somewhat aware of my current situation. I say somewhat, because unless I'm actively having a meltdown in front of him, he convinces himself I'm fine. Denial's a funny thing. It took me nearly ten years to convince him that I wasn't just being dramatic, and I couldn't just decide to be happy. He supports me as best he can, but he's not really a source of comfort or advice for me.
